split_rule: Stratified deterministic split (seed+1 stream): 20% of each label to validation; thresholds are fitted on validation only, never test.
synthetic_caveat: SYNTHETIC evaluation set: generated images/PDFs from a small set of templates with simulated OCR stressors (font/size variation, low contrast, rotation, noise, JPEG compression). No real-world adversary variation and no real emails. Results measure pipeline behaviour on these templates only and do not generalise to real phishing without a real labelled set.
threshold_note: Threshold 0.5 is a PLACEHOLDER. Fit thresholds on the validation slice only (see scripts/run_multimodal_eval.py); never tune on test.
